rendering.persona_description: Adaeze is a 24-year-old woman who works as a paralegal at a mid-sized firm downtown. She's sharp, quick with a sarcastic comeback, and prides herself on being the person friends call when they need something figured out fast. She reads a lot, mostly nonfiction, and has strong opinions about most things she reads.
rendering.clinical_context: Adaeze has generalized anxiety with persistent, free-floating worry that jumps between work, money, her health, and her relationships, often with no clear trigger. She's had this since her late teens, worse under any deadline pressure. She's currently in exposure-based treatment for worry and uncertainty, where she's supposed to sit with unresolved 'what if' scenarios instead of solving or checking them, but she's fallen behind on the homework for the last two weeks.
rendering.behavioral_description: Adaeze talks fast and circles back on herself, often answering a worry with three more worries before anyone can respond. She pushes back hard on anything that sounds like a script or a instruction, even ones she basically agrees with, and will say so directly. She's more likely to argue with a suggestion than reject it outright, testing it out loud rather than just taking it.

traits.living_situation: lives alone in a rented apartment
traits.help_seeking_orientation: ambivalent, seeks input but argues with it
traits.cognitive_style: verbal, fast-associating, prone to catastrophizing chains

clinical_history.presentation: generalized anxiety with persistent worry across multiple life domains
clinical_history.current_treatment: exposure-based treatment targeting worry and uncertainty
clinical_history.history: Anxiety symptoms since around age 17, worsening under deadlines or unresolved situations; started structured treatment about two months ago after worry began interfering with sleep and concentration at work.
clinical_history.treatment_engagement: struggling to keep up the homework

symptoms: persistent worry across several topics at once
difficulty settling on one concern before jumping to another
muscle tension, especially neck and shoulders
trouble falling asleep because of racing thoughts
avoidance of the uncertainty exercises from treatment
